register.labelZh: RUSH 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: rush around 和 rush round 可表示某人匆忙地在不同地方或工作之間奔波。；rush off 可表示某人很快便離開,往往比其他人預期的時間更早。；rush something out 可用來描述海報、通告、影片、門票或報告被迅速製作及推出。；rush something through 可表示計劃、規則、申請或訂單被迅速批准或處理,有時甚至沒有足夠時間仔細檢查。
register.summaryEn: Rush around and rush round help you describe someone who has to hurry from one place or task to another. Rush off shows that someone leaves quickly, often before other people expect them to leave. Rush something out can describe posters, notices, videos, tickets or reports that are produced and released very quickly. Rush something through can describe a plan, rule, request or order that is approved or processed quickly, sometimes without enough time for careful checking.

contextsEn: Talk about work produced under time pressure
